summary: Resolve exact private archive references from usage telemetry

delivery.outcome: Resolve request/response details from an explicit exact archive day/id supplied by instrumented callers, preserving payload-free metadata and historical unlinked rows.
nonGoals: No heuristic historical joins, model calls, provider/routing changes, writes to reserved client_routes.py, credentials or unreviewed runtime promotion.

architecture.decision: Add optional strictly validated archive_ref day/id to metadata ingest and journal. Read exact private records only after checking correlation and caller/function/provider/model/status bindings. Legacy databases remain readable without writes; missing, unavailable or mismatched references fail closed.
interfaceChanges: Optional archive_ref metadata on record-usage commands.

dataChanges.description: Add nullable exact archive day/id reference columns to the component-owned usage journal on writes only. No record ownership transfer, historical backfill or private payload movement.

architecture.rollback: Revert source; old readers ignore additive nullable journal columns.

validation.evidence: Private subllm-exact-archive-20261027 receipts and protected exact-head validation.
